ClaimDesk

Insurance claims operations

An independent insurance claims workspace with separate portals for policyholders, claims officers, service desk staff and administrators. It handles 11 personal and commercial insurance lines using fictional policies and records.

Stack
TypeScript, JavaScript, Cloudflare Workers, D1
Workflow
Claim intake, evidence review, examiner decisions and motor repair dispatch
Backend
Role-based access, duplicate protection, audit export and review deadlines
Live demo Source code
Project notes

To run the demo locally, clone the repository and run npm run dev with Node.js 22.13 or later. The browser opens with sample sign-in options for all four roles.

Try a travel claim with a baggage report, then switch to the claims officer portal to record an examiner decision. A motor claim takes a different path through repair assessment and simulated garage dispatch.
